wing_name: Network Share Opened, Then Mass Copy (Behaviour)
description: One person opens a network share and, within one hour, at least 20 files appear to have been copied into their own folders. UBA rules: network_share_access (ShellBags / LNK records of a \\server\share path) then file_copy_inferred (in Desktop / Documents / Downloads / Pictures / Videos / Music / OneDrive). The copy rule sees files arriving on this disk; it does not record where they came from.
proves: Files appear to have been copied into a person's folders soon after a network share was opened
author: Crow-Eye Team

steps.label: Files appear to have been copied in

conditions.value: ^(?:the Desktop|the Documents folder|the Downloads folder|the Pictures folder|the Videos folder|the Music folder|the OneDrive folder)$
